ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The rock in the figure as a whole has a form with a broad upper part and a narrow lower part, similar to “Queen’s Head,” with the neck obviously thinner than the head. Therefore the main coastal erosion action is seawater erosion.
